enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–3: 2 eggs in the rightmost column; 4–6: 2 in the rightmost two; 7–10: 3 in the rightmost three; 11–14: 4 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Insects first move on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.
